PURPOSE & CONTRACT COVERAGE 1.1 The selected service provider shall maintain the existing IP CCTV/NVR surveillan ce system for 12 months and restore all pre-existing defects, if any. 1.2 The accepted total contract price shall include the full priced scope of initial resto ration, preventive/corrective AMC services, labour, testing, travel, tools, included spa re parts and specified replacement items, if any. No separate charges for work expre ssly covered in the contract shall be entertained. 1.3 The published equipment inventory and defect schedule determine the priced obl igation; undisclosed or unlimited replacements are not automatically included. 1.4 GeM GTC, applicable STC/SLA, governing law, statutory preferences and approve d bid settings apply. Invalid or conflicting ATCs shall not prevail.

2. TECHNICAL ELIGIBILITY & BID DOCUMENTS 2.1 Bidder shall demonstrate relevant capacity in IP CCTV/NVR repair, maintenance, networking, recording and camera integration through verifiable work orders/complet ion records where experience is validly required by GeM bid settings. 2.2 Experience from government, PSU, autonomous, education and private clients of technically comparable nature may be accepted. No single client, district, brand, d ealership or particular firm shall be made a condition. 2.3 Bidder shall upload a signed item-wise compliance matrix (Annexure B), a restorat ion methodology, service support/escalation plan, technical manpower declaration an d a tools/test-instrument availability declaration 2.4 Technical capability shall include NVR configuration, IP address/network diagnos is, PoE, RJ45 termination and CAT-6 testing, camera integration, HDD troubleshooti ng and secure recording management. 2.5 Relevant statutory registration / GST / PAN information shall be furnished as app licable. Exemptions for eligible MSEs, startups and other categories shall be honore d as per GeM. 2.6 Evaluation shall be objective Pass/Fail against published requirements, with per mitted clarifications. False material statements may result in action according to co ntract and law; technical bids shall not contain price information unless the GeM for mat requires it. 3. SITE VISIT & PRE-BID INSPECTION 3.1 All prospective bidders are instructed to inspect the site and verify disclosed inst allation conditions before quoting. Subject to approval under the selected GeM cate gory, the buyer may prescribe the site visit certificate (Annexure C) as a mandatory bid document. 3.2 Site visits shall be available on the same published terms to all interested bidders during 09.11.26 to 19.11.26, 11 am to 4 pm. Appointments shall be arranged throu gh : Tarpan Mandal, Inspector, 9614777321. Buyer shall not collect a site inspectio n fee. 3.3 The visitor shall carry photo ID and an authorization from the bidder, and shall no t alter, disconnect, extract video, or access credentials without authorization. 3.4 On completion the designated buyer official shall sign Annexure C as factual confi rmation of attendance and accessible items inspected. Buyer shall not withhold sig natures arbitrarily. Certificate is not a technical qualification endorsement or award assurance 5. NVR / HDD / CAMERA TECHNICAL WORK 5.1 Specified NVR: IP channels, 2 SATA interfaces, fully integrated with supported in stalled/replacement cameras and approved storage, with live viewing, recording, pl ayback, date/time and approved network configuration. 5.2 Specified HDD: There should be recordings of at least 3 months in DVR/NVR and t he recordings should contain video of clearly visible persons and objects. If any pro blem occurs, the vendor should report within 12 hours. 5.3 The cameras should also produce night vision videos 5.4 Restore IP connectivity, camera authentication, channel mapping, scheduled reco

rding, NTP/time settings and approved viewing permissions. Do not disable channel s or lower recording quality to conceal a defect. 5.5 Faulty parts shall be repaired or replaced where expressly covered; any permane nt replacement shall be new, compatible and no lower than approved technical spe cifications. All removal/return of failed parts shall be recorded. 6. NETWORK, CABLING, RACK & MONITOR 6.1 Any PoE switch, power adapter, UPS or other component is covered only if include d in the published AMC inventory or restoration schedule; do not assume unlimited undisclosed quantities. 6.2 Supply/install 10 RJ45 connectors, CAT-6 cables etc., if necessary. 6.3 Restore the 6U rack and monitoring display, with appropriate mechanical/electric al safety and functional testing. 7. PREVENTIVE MAINTENANCE & REPORTING 7.1 At least one scheduled preventive maintenance visit shall be completed every mo nth, in addition to complaint-driven work. 7.2 Monthly checks shall include camera live view and image, NVR channel status, H DD SMART/health indications where supported, recording/playback sampling, networ k/PoE status, time synchronization, accessible cables/connectors and hardware cleanl iness 7.3 Submit camera-wise checklists and monthly service report within five working da ys after each month; record ticket opening, response, restoration, components replac ed and buyer acknowledgement. 7.4 Three recurrences of the same attributable fault within 30 days shall prompt a do cumented root-cause analysis within three working days and a corrective plan. 7.5 If any problem occurs, the vendor should report within 12 hours. 7.6 Proposed additional deductions, only where permitted and without duplication of GeM SLA deductions: 0.5% of monthly AMC charge per started 8-hour critical restor ation delay; 0.25% per started 24-hour non-critical delay; 2% for missed monthly P M visit; aggregate cap 10% of monthly AMC or lower governing cap. 7.7 Service deductions require a documented complaint history, attributable delay an d opportunity to explain. Default, termination and security remedies shall follow th e GeM contract and applicable law. 8. CYBERSECURITY, DATA & SAFETY 8.1 All footage, user accounts, NVR configuration and access details remain under b uyer control; no unauthorized copying, deletion, cloud upload, external remote logi n or credential sharing. 8.2 Buyer authorization is required before HDD formatting, storage removal, firmwa re update or potentially disruptive configuration change. Preserve footage where te chnically feasible. 8.3 Contractor shall employ safe power isolation, protected wiring and competent p ersonnel and shall secure permission before removing site assets.

8.4 At contract end, hand over updated asset register, camera mapping, approved c redentials, config. record, pending complaints, maintenance logs and a final health report. 9. ACCEPTANCE, PAYMENT & TECHNICAL EVALUATION 9.1 Technical compliance is Pass/Fail, against the full published requirements. Only t echnically responsive bidders proceed to financial evaluation under the selected Ge M procedure. 9.2 Buyer may seek permitted clarifications equally; no undisclosed preference, bidd er-specific advantage, selective certificate issuance or new technical test after bidd ing. 9.3 Final approval before upload shall confirm that the selected GeM category and se rvice SLA support all-inclusive initial restoration plus the specified item supplies/rep lacements. 9.4 The bidder should have Principal Place of Business address in West Bengal.
